newsitem.title: USA: Arnold, Motor Cargo end merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Arnold, Motor Cargo end merger talks.

text.p: Arnold Industries Inc said Tuesday it had ended negotiations to acquire Motor Cargo Industries Inc, a trucking concern based in Salt Lake City.
Details of the proposed acquisition proved complex and could not be resolved within a reasonable amount of time, said Arnold.
The company said it would now devote its energy to other areas of the transportation industry to enhance its growth and shareholder return.
